basic_info.description: Present an extraordinary opportunity to own two beautifully remodeled units in the heart of SF. Offer a combined total of nearly 2,500 sq ft of living space. These units feature modern upgrades, thoughtful design, and a fantastic shared outdoor area with beautiful Ocean and sunset View from the back deck, LR and front BD, making them perfect for multi-generational living or investment purposes.  Unit 508 is located on the third floor with 1,000 sq ft contains 2 BDs, 1 BA. Upgraded kitchen has brand new stainless appliances. It has bright, open living space, thanks to a newly installed skylight. Unit 506 has 1,000 sq ft contains 2 BDs, 1 BA on the second floor, new stainless appliances in the kitchen. Besides that there are 479 sq ft on the grand level, offering 2 legal storage rooms,1 bath, and living room with a wet-bar for extra living space. Each unit has been completely renovated with high-quality materials and contemporary finishes, ensuring move-in readiness. Situated near top-rated schools, grocery stores, easy access to shopping and restaurants located in West Portal, with public transit in West Portal and quick access to 19th Ave. This is an unique chance to own two stunning units in Golden Gate Height neighborhood.
